field.label: Top results
field.help: How many rows each ranking shows. Higher values make the reports larger and the device/domain matrix wider.

field.label: Default consumer period
field.help: The window the Consumers tab opens on. Shorter periods are faster but flow records are collected in daily buckets, so 'Today' can be empty until the bucket rolls over.

field.label: DNS attribution retention (days)
field.help: How long an observed IP-to-domain mapping is kept. Longer retention names more traffic but risks attributing an address that has since been reassigned.

field.label: Custom domain categories (JSON)
field.help: Object mapping category names to domain-suffix arrays. Built-in categories remain available.

field.label: Enable Prometheus metrics output
field.help: Expose metrics in Prometheus text format inside the metrics field of the report API.

field.label: Dashboard accent color
field.help: Accent colour for the charts, as a hex value such as #3b82f6.
